messages:
maya: Dropping a fresh Figma for API key management tweaks: rotate/revoke modal, reveal timing, empty state copy, and keyboard/a11y notes. proto: https://figma.com/file/xyz999 (placeholder)
eli: Quick copy nit: one-word CTAs in lists are ambiguous. Use `Rotate key` / `Revoke key` so context is clear when scanned.
jordan: Add `Used by X services` line under each key and a `View usage` action that opens a right drawer so people can inspect before rotating.
sam: Implementation detail: when we show a newly rotated key, the UI should focus the `Copy new key` button and not focus the raw key field so screen readers don't accidentally read the secret.
nora: A11y: use aria-live="polite" to announce outcomes: e.g., "New API key generated. Use the reveal control to view it." Never read the key material aloud. Also ensure reveal has aria-pressed state.
maya: How long should the key be visible? Proposing 12s visible time with a visible `Keep visible` toggle for power users (persisted per-user setting). We do 12s because mobile shoulder-surf is a concern but copying can be slow.
eli: Add accessible Copy label: `Copy new API key`. Toasts should be full sentences: `API key copied to clipboard.` and announced via role=alert.
sam: Backend exposes resp.one_time_key flag. Front snippet we can use: ```if (resp.one_time_key) { showOneTimeKey(resp.key); setAutoHide(12000); focus(copyBtn); }``` Also fallback to showing QR code for mobile if user opts in (unique idea): `Show as QR` for quick phone-to-phone transfer.
jordan: Revoke flow: for keys with usageCount >= 2 require typed confirmation (enter key name) instead of just a checkbox. For single-use keys keep the lighter confirm. Provide `Undo` snackbar for 25s after revoke.
nora: Visuals: don't rely on color; include a danger icon and visually hidden text for screen readers: `Danger: revoking this key will invalidate it`. Ensure contrast for icons and chips meets AA.
maya: Empty state: current line `You have no API keys yet.` is boring. Suggest: `No API keys yet 1 Create a key to start calling the API.` Under it show a one-line curl example and a small `Learn about scopes` link. CTA: `Create API key`.
eli: Keyboard flow: reveal must be a button in the tab order. Long-press to reveal only on touch devices; desktop reveal should be a click. Ensure focus doesn't jump when auto-hide occurs.
sam: Telemetry: record events `keys.rotate_shown`, `keys.rotate_confirmed`, `keys.rotate_copied` (boolean), and `keys.revoke_typed_confirm` to measure friction. Also log whether users used `Show as QR`.
jordan: Copy variants for modal body to A/B test: 
Variant Short: `Rotate key \u2014 a new key will be generated and the old one invalidated.`
Variant Supportive: `Rotate this key now \u2014 this will immediately make your current key stop working. Update any services that use it.`
nora: Prefer Supportive for clarity. For screen-reader users the extra sentence reduces ambiguous support queries.
maya: Thanks all 1 I'll update the Figma with: typed-confirm for multi-use revokes, QR reveal option, 12s default auto-hide with `Keep visible` toggle, ARIA notes (aria-live targets, focus targets), and the empty state curl. Filing ticket KEYUX-678 assigned to @sam. ETA: next sprint. :thumbsup:
